proves.claim: While the newest finished post-land main-wide test job is red and an item it carried is not yet pulled out, offerPulledLanding offers no sprint item and says MAIN_RED naming that job; a steady item is offered as before and a pending job never holds.

cli.landing.pull.sprint-holds-on-red-mai.why: A sprint item landed meanwhile would sit on the red tip the pull-out is about to revert.

proves.claim: Once the red post-land job's items are each pulled, or a later finished post-land job is green, the next offer sends the sprint item.

cli.landing.pull.sprint-resumes-after-gr.why: The hold must end by itself, or sprint landing would stop for good after one red main.

proves.claim: After a sprint landing breaks main and its pull-out records pulled, the next sprint item submitted through the CLI lands on the revert, never on the red tip.

cli.sprint.red-main-holds-next.why: Landing a second sprint item on a red main would carry the break into its merge.
